next.reason: 1985: a figurative-constant delimiter 'stands for a single character nonnumeric literal', and with ALL contiguous occurrences count as one, one occurrence moved per GR13d. §2023:14.9.48.4 GR7 restates both sentences: 'it stands for a single-character national literal if identifier-1 is a national data item; otherwise, it stands for a single-character alphanumeric literal', ALL folding identical, the move per GR11d (the renumbered 13d); §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR3 also fixes a non-ALL figurative constant at one character. 1985 SR2 makes identifier-1 alphanumeric, so the national branch never applies to a 1985 program. Same meaning.
